title: Your Nose Can Smell a Molecule's Mirror Image
description:
One molecule smells like spearmint, and its mirror image smells like caraway. Life itself picks one "hand", and the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry went to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai for showing how one hand can win.
